intro.text: Every key you’ll ever type is reached from one place: the home row. Let’s find it with your eyes closed (well, almost).
intro.tip: If your fingers ever get lost, feel for the bumps on F and J and you’re home again.

steps.title: Find the bumps
body: Look closely at the F and J keys on your keyboard – each has a tiny raised bump.
Rest your left index finger on F and your right index finger on J. Now press them both.

steps.title: Settle the rest of your fingers
body: Let your other fingers fall naturally onto the keys beside them: A S D F on the left, J K L ; on the right.
Your thumbs rest lightly on the space bar. Press each home key once to check every finger is in place.

steps.title: Walk along the home row
steps.instructions: Type each letter in turn. You can’t go wrong – the next key waits for you.

steps.title: One finger at a time
steps.text: a s d f j k l ; f j d k s l a ;
steps.instructions: Say each letter in your head as you press it, and keep your eyes up here.
